When a terminal flowered plant (T) is pollinated with an axial flowered plant (t), the offspring produced were 200 terminal flowered and 210 axial flowered. Which of the following represents the genotypes of the parents? TT x Tt Tt x Tt TT x tt Tt x tt T x t Choose Answer : - -
